subject: Minute-level spike surcharge waiver & pricing framework
messages:
From: Alex Cho <ops@brightcart.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightCart Billing <billing@brightcart.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Unexpected minute-level surcharge on 11/30 invoice

Hi Rafael,

We noticed a large surcharge on our 11/30 invoice for minute-level spikes — the line item shows an overrun charge of $12,450. The raw usage graph attached shows several very short (1–3 minute) bursts during our deploy that we believe were transient.

Can Redwood consider waiving or reducing that particular surcharge? Our account team and finance are aligned that these spikes were not representative and we were within our expected daily throughput aside from the brief deploy window.

If a full waiver isn't possible, can we discuss converting the overrun to a temporary quota bump (blended rate) for November with a single pro forma amendment? We're targeting a Q1 expansion and would prefer resolution without a lengthy appeals process.

Thanks,
Alex Cho
Ops Lead, BrightCart
[Attachment: brightcart-minute-spike-20261130.png (PNG, 480KB)]
[Attachment: 20261130-brightcart-spike-invoice.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Cho <ops@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected minute-level surcharge on 11/30 invoice

Alex — thanks for sending this over and for the clear attachments. I pulled the usage logs and see the same pattern: four brief spikes between 11:30–11:36 UTC that triggered our per-minute overrun banding.

Proposed path:
- Short term: we can offer a partial waiver of 60% of the surcharge as a one-time customer goodwill credit contingent on a short amendment that converts the remaining overrun to a temporary +30% quota for November billed at a blended rate (50% of standard overrun price).
- Process: if you accept, I'll loop in Ben (sales ops) and Marissa (account lead) to draft an amendment and get finance sign-off. We can route the DocuSign to Billing for final approval.

This keeps the invoice tidy for your finance team and avoids changing long-term commit terms. If you'd prefer a full waiver, we need a short internal approval but it will take longer and is unlikely for repeat incidents.

Would you like me to prepare the amendment for signature today?

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
[phone]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: BrightCart surcharge — provisional approval?

Rafael / Marissa,

Quick internal note: finance okayed a provisional credit up to $8k for one-off minute-level spikes if we convert remainder to a temporary quota bump with blended pricing. Two caveats: 1) must be one-time (mark renewal notes), and 2) legal needs the amendment to include explicit non-precedent language.

If you want the DocuSign pre-populated, I can draft the payment/credit terms and send to Legal. Otherwise Rafael, happy for you to confirm the 60% goodwill credit and blended-rate path you suggested.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: provisional-credit-memo.pdf (PDF, 45KB)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Cho <ops@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, BrightCart Billing <billing@brightcart.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 13:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected minute-level surcharge on 11/30 invoice

Alex — looping back with the path Ben confirmed. Summary of the proposed resolution:

1) One-time goodwill credit: 60% of the surcharge amount ($7,470) applied to your December invoice.
2) Remaining overrun ($4,980) converted to a temporary November quota increase equal to the overrun volume, billed at a blended rate (50% of standard overrun rate).
3) Legal language: amendment will explicitly state this is a non-precedent, one-off accommodation and will be marked in your contract notes.

If that works, I'll send the amendment via DocuSign (pre-filled) for your billing contact to sign. Target turnaround: sign within 48 hours so we can apply the credit in December.

Next steps (for Alex / BrightCart):
- Reply with sign-off or any objections to the two-line summary above.
- If accepted, Billing signs the amendment link.

Thanks — Rafael
[Attachment: draft-amendment-summary.txt (TXT, 2KB)]

From: Alex Cho <ops@brightcart.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightCart Billing <billing@brightcart.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected minute-level surcharge on 11/30 invoice

Rafael — that sounds reasonable and appreciated. BrightCart accepts the 60% goodwill credit and the blended-rate conversion for the remainder.

Please send the DocuSign to billing@brightcart.com and copy me. We'll review and aim to sign within 24–48 hours. Quick note: please include the month that the credit will be applied (December) in the amendment so our AP team has the memo.

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Looking forward to a clean resolution — will escalate internally to ensure the deploy pattern is addressed on our side.

Alex Cho
Ops Lead, BrightCart
